title: U-Mamba
paper_title: U-Mamba: Enhancing Long-range Dependency for Biomedical Image Segmentation
core_mech: 在 nnU-Net 风格 residual CNN encoder/bottleneck 中插入 selective SSM，同时保留 CNN long skips。
core_mech_en: Embeds flattened 1D selective Mamba blocks inside an nnU-Net-style residual CNN encoder/bottleneck while retaining CNN decoder and long skips.
input_desc: 2D/3D 医学影像与 nnU-Net 数据配置
input_en: 2D or 3D medical image within the automated nnU-Net pipeline
output_en: Dense pixel- or voxel-level segmentation map

adapter.name: U-Mamba (bottleneck mechanism)
adapter.mechanism: Residual convolution U-shaped encoder/decoder with authors' Mamba block on flattened bottleneck features.
limitations: Random initialization and synthetic data; no original benchmark result or pretrained capability is reproduced.
Compact bottleneck variant only; nnU-Net planning and the full U-Mamba_Bot/Enc training pipelines are not reproduced.

verification.title: U-Mamba

limitations: Random initialization and synthetic data; no original benchmark result or pretrained capability is reproduced.
